annotations.title: Quarterly results of a GPW company

description: Quarterly financial KPIs of a GPW company: revenue, EBITDA, EBIT, net income, EPS, balance sheet and cash flow, reported and adjusted. Instruments resolve by ticker, alias or ISIN. Coverage varies by company and quarter, and missing data is not zero. Monetary `...PLN` fields are in millions of the issuer's reporting currency, given in the row's `currency` field, which can be EUR or USD; EPS fields are per share. `values.<field>` carries value, currency, unit, report date and source URL, and a field without complete provenance is absent. `dataQuality.blocksComputation: true` marks a row our checks do not trust. `withheld` lists fields returned as null by a data-quality rule, with the rule and reason; a null can also mean the field was excluded as not issuer-sourced. `reportScope` tells standalone from consolidated figures, and is null when unknown.

quartersBack.description: How many recent quarters to return. Default 8, max 20.
